about: Readable taker terms: Trade vectors, v5. Spec: SPEC-v5.md. Every integer is a JSON decimal string, except domain.chainId, check, summary_len and signed_what.chainId / signed_what.v (JSON numbers). Computed by eth_account 0.14 + eth_abi 6 (Python) and viem 2.57.2 (Node), byte-equal; signatures and hidden-word commitments also equal under cast 1.5.1. Keys are publicly known anvil private keys: never fund them.
